notes.title: Patch Notes - 1176
notes.notes:
Runners, todays patch enables the character selection screen to be accessed via the End of Game selection screen.

Now you can change your Runners appearance without having to return to the main menu IN TER FACE!

There are also several bug fixes included in todays deployment including some changes to quest rewards, some of these were being very generous with dishing out the skill points.
Enemy invasions no longer happen in Arena Mode until reaching Arena Level 5.
Various crash fixes have also been applied!

Enjoy the new build Runners, report back to Corp if you discover anything that shouldn't be doing what it's doing!

Corp HQ OUT!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1166
notes.notes:
Good grief Runners, we have another update for you from Corp HQ!

Good news for those of you after a little more Neon in your augmented eyes, the U ZER IN TER FACE has been upgraded for just such a task! Go check that out and let Corp know how badly your eyes suffered!

A whole slurry of nasty bugs have been squished along the way from buttons that you shouldn't have been able to interact with to NEW buttons to help aid in your understanding of what things may or may not actually do!

[list]
[*]Removed the water effect from the mid level "adjustment" phase.
[*]Tried to stop the Quest Machine doing stupid things!
[*]Added some new random voice lines (we know how much you love those!
[*]Adjusted level aesthetics to be more randomised and have various patterns applied to the overall look.
[*]Gave the enemy bullets a little boost to their visuals to allow you to, er, actually see them in some circumstances!
[*]A visual boosty to the Sticky Tar Pools!
[*]Stop the Tiny Level modifier from making the levels far too tiny!
[*]Stop player movement input if the game is paused, in some circumstances (like literally a single frame) could cause the player to wonder off in strange directions unintentionally when the game is resumed...
[*]Stopped you from being able to collect more than one Random Chest at a time!
[*]Adjusted various balance mechanics, XP has been "tweaked".
[*]Added some additional T1 Enemies!
[*]Had many energy boosting drinks!
[/list]

That's it for now, Runners! Remember to go shout at Corp via the usual channels if they have messed something up! They are not the brightest sparks....

We out! o7

notes.title: Development Build update - 1123
notes.notes:
Why hello there Runners!

Corp have pulled something out of their box of tricks that we were just not expecting!

A full Character unlock system has been added!

While this system is still very much in it's early days, Corp has said there will likely be changes as we go.
Characters are now unlocked currently through two mechanisms with more to be added at a later date.
Firstly as you level up your Player level this will unlock a new Character every 5 levels.
Secondly as you reach higher Arena Levels new Characters will be unlocked around every 5th level,

Each Character currently has a placeholder set of Base stats that you can build upon and these will most certainly change to add Character build diversity. Currently all Character stats are linear increases or decreases with each new Character unlock.

Next, Character unlocks are fully persistent!  The only way to fully remove your unlocked characters will be to manually delete the save file and overwrite the cloud save. Deleting your save from the Options menu will not affect collected Characters!

On to the other changes!

A further 16 Characters have been added!
Fixed a bug with Boomerangs that were pushing Boss' around!
Some other minor tweaks and improvements to UI and Gameplay.

As always Runners, we hope you enjoy this update and do feel free to join the Discord to let us know if there is anything you like or dislike about the ongoing changes.

Stay safe out there!

Corp

notes.title: Development Update - 1098 - Quest Refactor
notes.notes:
Happy weekend Runners!

We have a quick update from Corp today that reshapes how quests are delivered to the Runners in the circuit.

Previously Quests were being generated when the level loaded and they would be automatically deployed to the Runners neural net. Quests were also given out for Easy, Medium and Hard all at once.

Now you can only acquire Quests from the Quest Machine after a set period of time once the Circuit is Active!
To get a quest, just walk near the Quest machine (which will be indicated to you on the Mini-Map with a pulsing "Scroll" Icon) and you will automatically collect an Easy Quest during Wave 1, Medium and below at Wave 2 and Hard and below at Wave 3 and above.

You can still carry all 3 Quest Difficulties which will all be tracked independently!

As always Runners, if there is any feedback you wish to let Corp know about, join the Discord or post on the Community Hub.

Happy Running!

notes.title: Development Branch Update - 1085 - New Feature Added! - Endless Mode!
notes.notes:
Well hello there Runners!

Today, a Sunday has seen the addition of a brand new game mode, Endless Mode!

This is only available on the development branch so please switch over if you would like to try it out!

This mode can be accessed from the Level Select screen and will take you on an endless journey till you can take no more!
Well eventually it will, it's in it's early stages at the moment and has been capped to Game Level 10 until it has been refined by Corp anyway.

We are sure that this new mode combined with the new Quests and the even newer Level Modifiers are sure to anger some, but we expect to see no mercy from the Runners out there who will attempt to beat it!

Have a blast at this new mode and be sure to leave some feedback for Corp and ruin their day!

notes.title: New Feature added - QUESTS!
notes.notes:
Hello Runners!

It's been an exciting week at Corp HQ. We have been busy looking at all the data coming in and getting ready for this update!

The Developer beta branch has now been made public for you to try out new builds of the game that may include new experimental features that will probably break!
This build will move to main branch when testing has completed and we are happy with the new stuff!

Here are a few notes from the suits for you to consume.


[list]
[*]Adjusted Lighting and various shaders to make the game look a little different!
[*]Added a new feature - QUESTS!
[*]You are now presented with 3 Randomly Generated Quests at the start of each level.
[*]There is an Easy, Medium and Hard Quest that pull from a pool of quests so it is possible to get the same quest for all three! However the Requirements will be higher!
[*]There are only currently a few Random Types of Quests to start with so this feature can fleshed out
[*]Survive - You must not take any damage for x number of seconds (if you have a shield this does NOT count towards taking damage)
[*]Collect - You must collect x amount of Copper, Gold or Platinum (there is one quest for each resource type)
[*]Runes - You must collect x amount of Runs for the Quantum Prism
[/list]

Upon completing any quest you will be reward with X amount of copper. you will also be rewarded with a hidden message which will allow you to discover and eventually unlock an ultimate ability from the Quantum Prism

Be careful out there Runners, we will be in comms with you again real soon!

notes.title: Circuit Runner Early Access!
notes.notes:
Get your legs powered up as Circuit Runner Early Access is coming to Steam on August the 26th!

We are getting ready to unleash the first public Early Access release for you to play and help us get ready for Launch! Will there be bugs, of course! Will there be adjustments to gameplay based on YOUR feedback, of course!

Either join our Discord or use the Community Hub to let use know what you think. If you seriously want to contribute to the game, then get your ideas in ahead of launch!

Early Access will go live with the following Features.

[list]
[*] At least 8 Playable Characters that have some customisation.
[*] At least 10 Different Voice Styles for your Character.
[*] At least 10 Different Auto Fire Skills.
[*] At least 18 Synergies that are based on your Skill choices.
[*] At least 8 Passive Skills to help you build your Character in different ways.
[*] There is no Character Level limit, however all Skills have a level cap of 100.
[*] Arena Level is Locked at a maximum level of 50 (Good luck getting there Runner!).
[*] Steam Leaderboards for each Difficulty.
[*] The Quantum Prism with at least 3 Unlockable extras.
[*] English, French, German, Italian and Spanish UI.
[*] At least 5 different Enemy types.
[*] At least 6 different Boss types with simple mechanics.
[/list]

The full 1.0 Version will build upon this foundation and will release in around 6 to 8 months after Early access has started.

Thank you Runners, see you in the Arena!
